meta.name: Focus Keeper
meta.creator: CardSpoke Team
meta.description: Adds a desk-lamp focus ring when editing cards

css: .fk-card-shell { position: relative; } .fk-focus-halo { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; inset: -6px; border-radius: 18px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg, #0b1021) 92%, var(--accent, #d1843c) 8%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #d1843c) 70%, transparent); transition: box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease; } .fk-card-shell:focus-within .fk-focus-halo { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #d1843c) 70%, transparent), 0 0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #d1843c) 25%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg, #0b1021) 85%, var(--accent, #d1843c) 15%); }
